global_caption: The overall tone is dominated by golden morning light and soft backlighting.
shot1: Shot 1 fades in from black, starting with a wide overhead shot. A forest clearing is filled with pixelated morning mist and warm golden sunlight. Foreground shows dew-drenched grass blades shimmering; background features layered tree trunks forming leading lines. Five big-eyed elves run in from different edges of the frame toward the center. Composition shifts from scattered to semi-circular convergence. Lighting is soft natural morning light, with subtle golden rims on faces and ear tips. They begin with gentle humming to establish harmony.
shot2: Shot 2 connects with previous shot via hard cut into a medium eye-level tracking shot. The formation naturally extends along a stream winding through the forest. Foreground water flows with flickering bright pixel highlights; background tree shadows rapidly recede, creating depth. The low When hearing “亮”, one elf looks up toward a beam of light piercing through the treetops.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions via match cut on water surface highlights to seaside rocks, using a wide-level eye-level slightly low-angle shot. Foreground shows wet reflective rock edges; midground features elves split into left and right groups; background includes warm-toned pixel sea and crashing waves. The scene continues morning light but with more noticeable sea breeze. Lighting remains consistent soft warm natural light.
shot4: Shot 4 enters the grassy hillside via a slight whip pan hard cut from previous shot, using a moving shot transitioning from medium-close overhead to eye-level. Foreground shows grass blades bent by wind and springing back; background faintly reveals higher ridgelines. Warm tone remains consistent, sunlight becomes more abundant but not overly harsh.
shot5: Shot 5 transitions via fade-in match upward to the mountain peak, using a wide extreme long shot with slight upward angle. The summit is open, sky illuminated by warm orange backlight. Five big-eyed elves stand at the edge in a low-to-high triangular composition. Foreground grass tips are outlined in gold by backlight; background distant mountains and sea compress into glowing pixel layers. Lighting reaches its strongest point in the film but maintains consistent golden backlight style.
shot6: Foreground shows thin snow-covered rock surfaces and fine snow particles gently swept by wind; midground shows five elves standing closely together; background features snow slopes and sky bathed in warm afterglow. Though at high altitude, the color tone remains warm gold-orange, avoiding cold aesthetics. They cease large movements and stand shoulder-to-shoulder steadily, gently extending the final note’s ending. The low Lips transition from full opening to gradual closure, eyes shift from gazing at mountains and sea to meeting each other. Wind The camera continues pulling back, slowly integrating them from clear subjects into the grand snowy landscape, holding the lingering echo and backlight silhouette for the final half-second to complete the conclusion.
